claim_text: Conditional QQQ exposure estimates differ across the predeclared BTC ETF-era split: BTC 1.03 to 0.93 (change p=0.611); ETH 1.33 to 1.51 (change p=0.520).
method: 252-session multivariate HAC exposures and formal era interactions.
uncertainty: Intervals, diagnostics, and sensitivity specifications are reported in the linked source tables.
limitation: The split is descriptive; contemporaneous exposures do not identify ETF effects or causal transmission.
